reason: A web client ergonomics plugin that improves chat session and input handling with new-session navigation, per-session history, generation cancellation, and keyboard editing shortcuts.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页会话提供新建会话、输入历史回溯、生成中断和快捷文本清除等交互优化。
summaries.en: Improves DSH web chat ergonomics with new-session navigation, per-session input history, generation cancellation, and keyboard editing shortcuts.

capabilities: Registers a /new command to create and switch to a blank session
Maintains per-session input history and restores drafts
Intercepts keyboard shortcuts for history navigation, generation cancellation, and text deletion
Reads session trajectory data to rebuild input history
